gloss: cancellation; discontinuation; termination; ending (of a series)

definitions.explanation: bringing something to an end before its natural conclusion, often prematurely; commonly used for TV shows, manga series, and projects being cancelled

examples.japanese: ドラマが{低視聴率|ていしちょうりつ}で{打|う}ち{切|き}りになった。
examples.english: The drama was cancelled due to low ratings.

examples.japanese: {連載|れんさい}の{打|う}ち{切|き}りが{決|き}まった。
examples.english: The serialization was decided to be discontinued.

examples.japanese: {資金不足|しきんぶそく}で{事業|じぎょう}が{打|う}ち{切|き}りになる。
examples.english: The project will be terminated due to lack of funds.

notes:
FORMATION:
{打|う}つ (to strike) + {切|き}る (to cut) → to cut off, discontinue

COMMON CONTEXTS:
- {番組|ばんぐみ}の{打|う}ち{切|き}り (TV program cancellation)
- {連載|れんさい}の{打|う}ち{切|き}り (manga/novel serialization cancellation)
- {事業|じぎょう}の{打|う}ち{切|き}り (project termination)
- {補助|ほじょ}の{打|う}ち{切|き}り (subsidy cutoff)
- {支援|しえん}の{打|う}ち{切|き}り (support termination)

MANGA/ANIME USAGE:
In manga, {打|う}ち{切|き}り refers to a series being cancelled before its intended ending, often resulting in a rushed conclusion.

VERB FORM:
- {打|う}ち{切|き}る (to cancel, discontinue)
- {打|う}ち{切|き}りになる (to be cancelled)

RELATED:
- {中止|ちゅうし} (suspension, calling off)
- {終了|しゅうりょう} (ending, conclusion)
- {廃止|はいし} (abolition)
- {完結|かんけつ} (completion - natural ending)
